description: Golden Dataset for Agent Evaluation. 覆盖正常/表达变化/边界/安全/权限场景，含 ground truth result。

cases.question: 2025年11月华东区域销售额同比变化

ground_truth.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', sale_date) AS month_start, SUM(sales_amount) AS value FROM v_sales_enriched WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-01' AND DATE '2025-11-30' AND region_name = '华东' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', sale_date) ORDER BY date_trunc('month', sale_date)

SELECT date_trunc('month', sale_date) AS month_start, region_name, SUM(sales_amount) AS value FROM v_sales_enriched WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', sale_date), region_name ORDER BY date_trunc('month', sale_date), region_name

cases.question: 过去6个月各区域毛利率趋势

ground_truth.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', sale_date) AS month_start, region_name, SUM(gross_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(sales_amount), 0) AS value FROM v_sales_enriched WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', sale_date), region_name ORDER BY date_trunc('month', sale_date), region_name
